source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This landing keeps the found-item response action when the invited attendee still has NEEDS-ACTION and SEQUENCE matches, unless revision checks are disabled. That equality branch ignores DTSTAMP; the adjacent update path still uses the composite sequence/stamp comparison. The regression test recreates a later stamped stored item and checks both response controls and preservation of the other attendee's accepted state. Its adopted wait returns lastModifiedTime before separate status assertions. The accepted code later expands selected-calendar routing and async completion, while the UI can still override computed options. No global stamp-ignoring rule, all-provider fix or runtime result follows.
title: Pending invitation responses use sequence equality without a stamp check in one found-item branch
